name: Luma
_why_scale: 0.63x Mario (Nick: the Lumas are slightly too small at 0.77)
_why_item_ability: Label audit: Luma bats with Star Bits (batting_item), like Rosalina, Lubba and the other Lumas, who show Star Bit Storm; no Super Dive (Nick)
_why_hitting_ability: Nick (labels-8: 'Luma on the captain screen is missing one', 'make room for four'): Luma gets a star at bat too (batter_star.STAR_CHARS), so its card and captain select show all four: Launch Star, Star Shower, Star Get (its own row with the bat icon, not the star swing row), Star Bit Storm
_why_new_id: Was Extra Innings' stock-slot id 0x4B, the yellow Luma (ei_characters.py, STOCK_* in charbuild.py). Nick: on the clean base no stock-slot characters, every character the same way (docs/stock-slot-migration.md)
_why_template: Extra Innings' dir 0x5D is Boo's layout; its files 3-14 are byte-identical to Boo's (dir 0x20) in the clean game. Boo's size, hitbox and per-character floats rows equal Extra Innings' Luma rows, and Boo's hand-node pair is (2, 3), the pair charbuild 9a patched Extra Innings' Luma to: neither fix is needed with Boo as the template
_why_model: Our Galaxy Luma (Tico rip) over Boo's layout. File 1 = the high block, as Extra Innings' Luma dir ships (153,920 B each). Files 6-14: its own animation banks, Boo's with the hover bob flattened and the root held 0.10 lower (scripts/flatten_hover.py -> models/work/luma-own/anim): on Boo's own banks the Luma floated up to 0.5 off the ground at the top of every bob and sank 0.23 into it in the fielding crouch.

bat._why: Peach's bat with a Luma star sticker: python scripts/bat_recolors.py luma

_why_star_pitch: Launch Star, star pitch 14 (pitch_launch_star.py, docs/launch-star.md): a high, fast pitch fired off a Launch Star (Nick). Was 0: no star pitch
_why_stats: Its stats row as charbuild builds it today: git-8a's balance pass (STOCK_ROWS), "???" from Extra Innings, and the captain flag + star swing 1 (Fire in menus; custom_swings makes it 15, Star Shower, in play) that star_swing_stats set for it
_why_table_stats: Nick's review editor (STOCK_TABLE_EDITS): worst normal catch radius in the game (the 70 floor), the 80 floor, worst centered-catch radius
_why_table_rows: Today's per-character rows (Extra Innings' data for stock slot 0x4B, catch radii after STOCK_TABLE_EDITS) where they differ from Boo's: TABLES name -> whole row, hex. Inert until charbuild reads "table_rows" (docs/stock-slot-migration.md): applied after the template's row is copied, before table_stats
_why_strike_zone: python scripts/strike_zones.py --write: Boo's zone sits 53% of the way up its body in the batting stance (0.950 on 0.33..1.51); this body is 0.02..1.35, so 0.720 (the template's 0.950 would sit at 70%). World height = this x sizescale x scale
